modes.name_zh: 马克思主义基本原理学习法
modes.definition_zh: 运用辩证法和历史唯物主义分析马克思主义基本原理，把握其内在逻辑和发展规律，理解理论在具体实践中的指导意义。
modes.definition_en: Apply dialectical materialism and historical materialism to analyze the basic principles of Marxism, grasp their internal logic and development patterns, and understand their guiding significance in concrete practice.
process_zh: 系统学习马克思主义基本原理
分析理论内在逻辑
联系具体实践理解指导意义
process_en: Systematically study the basic principles of Marxism
Analyze the internal logic of the theory
Connect with specific practice to understand guiding significance
modes.key_quote_zh: 实践是检验真理的唯一标准
modes.key_quote_en: Practice is the sole criterion for testing truth
representative_cases_zh: 在革命实践中运用马克思主义指导实践
在理论学习中联系当代问题
representative_cases_en: Guided practice in revolutionary practice using Marxism
Connected with contemporary issues in theoretical study

modes.definition_zh: 从革命实践的角度分析问题，把握革命发展的一般规律，理解历史条件对革命的制约作用，以及在具体实践中推动变革的可能性。
modes.definition_en: Analyze problems from the perspective of revolutionary practice, grasp the general patterns of revolutionary development, understand the constraining effects of historical conditions on revolution, and explore possibilities for change under specific circumstances.
process_zh: 考察革命在历史长河中的发展轨迹
分析特定历史条件下的现实制约
把握革命发展趋势和时代特征
在历史大背景下规划未来发展
process_en: Examine the developmental trajectory of things in the long river of history
Analyze the constraints of reality under specific historical conditions
Grasp the historical development trends and characteristics of the times
Plan future development within the broader historical context
modes.key_quote_zh: 战争是革命的造血机器
modes.key_quote_en: War is the blood-producing machine of revolution
representative_cases_zh: 分析井冈山根据地的建设经验
总结抗日战争的作战经验
representative_cases_en: Analyzed the construction experience of the Jinggangshan base area
Summarized the combat experience of the Anti-Japanese War

modes.definition_zh: 以民族独立为核心出发点，分析国家主权、民族尊严和发展权的内在联系，把握实现民族独立的道路和方法。
modes.definition_en: Taking national independence as the core starting point, analyze the internal connections of national sovereignty, national dignity, and development rights, and grasp the roads and methods for achieving national independence.
process_zh: 分析民族独立的现状和困难
把握独立的基本路径和策略
评估各种实现方式的可行性
process_en: Analyze the current situation and difficulties of national independence
Grasp the basic paths and strategies for independence
Assess the feasibility of various ways to achieve independence
modes.key_quote_en: The Chinese people have stood up
representative_cases_zh: 分析近代中国的民族独立运动
研究民族独立的理论探讨
representative_cases_en: Analyzed the national independence movement in modern China
Researched theoretical discussions on national independence

modes.definition_zh: 运用系统思维分析社会主义建设的各个方面，把握经济、政治、文化等各项事业协调发展的规律，制定科学的建设方案。
modes.definition_en: Apply systems thinking to analyze various aspects of socialist construction, grasp the patterns of coordinated development of economy, politics, culture and other endeavors, and formulate scientific construction plans.
process_zh: 识别社会主义建设的各个要素和结构
分析各要素间的相互作用和制约
制定协调发展的方案
评估建设效果并进行调整
process_en: Identify various elements and structures of socialist construction
Analyze interactions and constraints between elements
Formulate plans for coordinated development
Evaluate construction results and make adjustments
representative_cases_zh: 分析改革开放以来的经济建设经验
研究社会主义制度的完善路径
representative_cases_en: Analyzed the economic construction experience since reform and opening up
Researched the path of perfecting the socialist system

modes.definition_zh: 在批判继承传统思想的基础上进行创新，打破思维定势，提出新观点新方法，推动社会主义事业的不断前进。
modes.definition_en: On the basis of critically inheriting traditional thought, carry out innovation, break through mental stereotypes, propose new viewpoints and methods, and promote the continuous development of the cause of socialism.
process_zh: 批判分析现有的思想和制度
识别思维定势和局限
寻求突破和创新路径
提出新的理论观点和实践方法
process_en: Critically analyze existing thought and institutions
Identify mental stereotypes and limitations
Seek breakthrough and innovation paths
Propose new theoretical viewpoints and practical methods
modes.key_quote_en: Without breaking there is no establishing
representative_cases_zh: 分析改革开放的历史经验
研究创新在社会主义建设中的作用
representative_cases_en: Analyzed the historical experience of reform and opening up
Researched the role of innovation in socialist construction

modes.name_en: Seeking Truth from Facts Analysis Method
modes.domain_en: Seeking Truth from Facts / Knowledge-Action Unity
modes.definition_zh: 以事实为依据，追求真理本质，坚持实事求是的态度，将理论与实践相结合，在具体实践中检验和发展认识，避免主观臆断和空谈。
modes.definition_en: Take facts as the basis, pursue the essence of truth, adhere to the attitude of seeking truth from facts, combine theory with practice, and test and develop knowledge through concrete practice, avoiding subjective speculation and empty talk.
process_zh: 深入调查研究实际情况
基于客观事实分析问题
制定切实可行的方案
在实践中检验认识
process_en: Conduct in-depth investigation and research of actual situations
Analyze problems based on objective facts
Formulate practical and feasible solutions
Test knowledge through practice
modes.key_quote_zh: 实事求是，一切从实际出发
modes.key_quote_en: Seek truth from facts, everything starts from actual conditions
representative_cases_zh: 以调研为基础制定改革方案
在具体工作中贯彻求真务实精神
representative_cases_en: Formulated reform plans based on in-depth research
Upheld truth-seeking spirit in concrete work

modes.definition_zh: 立足全局和长远，把握发展趋势和规律，统筹兼顾各方面因素，制定具有前瞻性的战略规划，在动态变化中保持战略定力。
modes.definition_en: Stand on the overall situation and long-term, grasp development trends and patterns, balance various factors comprehensively, formulate forward-looking strategic planning, and maintain strategic stability amidst dynamic changes.
process_zh: 分析全局形势和发展趋势
识别关键制约因素
制定阶段性战略目标
保持战略定力和灵活性
process_en: Analyze overall situation and development trends
Identify key constraining factors
Formulate phased strategic goals
Maintain strategic stability and flexibility
modes.key_quote_zh: 不谋全局者，不足谋一域
modes.key_quote_en: Those who do not plan for the whole cannot plan for a part
representative_cases_zh: 制定国家经济和社会发展规划
研究长远的战略目标和路径
representative_cases_en: Formulated national economic and social development plans
Researched long-term strategic goals and paths

modes.definition_zh: 运用辩证唯物主义的观点和方法，分析事物发展的内在矛盾和规律，把握质变量变、肯定否定等辩证规律，在分析中寻求解决问题的方法。
modes.definition_en: Apply the viewpoints and methods of dialectical materialism to analyze the internal contradictions and laws of development, grasp dialectical laws such as qualitative-quantitative change and affirmation-negation, and seek solutions to problems through analysis.
process_zh: 识别分析对象中的主要矛盾
分析矛盾的发展变化规律
把握转化的关键节点
寻求矛盾转化的路径
process_en: Identify the main contradictions in the object of analysis
Analyze the laws of development and change of contradictions
Grasp the key nodes of transformation
Seek paths for contradiction transformation
modes.key_quote_zh: 矛盾的普遍性和特殊性是辩证分析的基础
modes.key_quote_en: The universality and particularity of contradictions are the foundation of dialectical analysis
representative_cases_zh: 分析改革过程中各种矛盾
在利益调整中寻求平衡点
representative_cases_en: Analyzed various contradictions in the reform process
Sought balance points amid interest adjustments

modes.definition_zh: 融会贯通各种思想精华，在继承传统的基础上进行创新突破，形成独特的理论体系和实践方法，推动思想和实践的双重发展。
modes.definition_en: Integrate the essence of various kinds of thought, carry out innovative breakthroughs on the basis of tradition, form unique theoretical systems and practical methods, and promote the dual development of thought and practice.
process_zh: 系统学习和借鉴各种思想精华
批判继承传统思想
在实践中检验和完善
形成独特理论体系
process_en: Systematically learn and draw on the essence of various kinds of thought
Critically inherit traditional thought
Test and improve through practice
Form unique theoretical systems
modes.key_quote_en: Learn from all and become unique
representative_cases_zh: 在理论研究中综合运用多种方法
在实践中形成独特的改革路径
representative_cases_en: Comprehensively applied multiple methods in theoretical research
Formed unique reform paths through practice
